s: Ukraine (a country in Eastern Europe, bordering on the north shore of the Black Sea)

Ukelei.et: From Middle High German, via Old Sorbian *ukleja from Proto-Slavic *uklěja.

s: Ukrainian (male or of unspecified gender) (ethnic Ukrainian or citizen of Ukraine)
Ukrainian (female) (ethnic Ukrainian or citizen of Ukraine)
of Ukraine; Ukrainian (relating to Ukraine or its people)

Ukas.et: 18th century, borrowed from Russian ука́з (ukáz, “edict, decree”).

Ukulele.et: From English ukulele, from Hawaiian ʻukulele, from ʻuku (“flea”) + lele (“jump, jumping”).
